title: Return semantics
statement: Let a nondeterministic register program have a state $l$ whose instruction immediately returns the Boolean value $b$. If the configuration $(l,v,	ext{no answer})$ satisfies the guard, then it has probabilistic semantics with acceptance probability $1$ when $b$ is true and $0$ when $b$ is false.
hypotheses_covered: The instruction at state $l$ immediately returns Boolean value $b$
